scenes.self: In the interview, the hiring manager reads my resume, taps a pen on the gap, and asks why I was not hired sooner.
scenes.other: In the interview, the hiring manager reads her resume, taps a pen on the gap, and asks why she was not hired sooner.

scenes.self: The teacher calls my name during class; thirty students turn around, and I stare at the blank space in my notebook.
scenes.other: The teacher calls her name during class; thirty students turn around, and she stares at the blank space in her notebook.

scenes.self: At the party, a circle of friends bursts into laughter at an inside joke, and I stand by the snack table holding a warm drink.
scenes.other: At the party, a circle of friends bursts into laughter at an inside joke, and she stands by the snack table holding a warm drink.

scenes.self: At dinner, my aunt lists my cousin's new promotion, then turns to me and asks what I have been doing with my degree.
scenes.other: At dinner, her aunt lists her cousin's new promotion, then turns to her and asks what she has been doing with her degree.

scenes.self: The fitness instructor stops the class, walks over, and adjusts my arms while I stand still and everyone else watches in the mirror.
scenes.other: The fitness instructor stops the class, walks over, and adjusts his arms while he stands still and everyone else watches in the mirror.

scenes.self: At the wedding, I am seated at a table of strangers who talk among themselves, and no one asks my name.
scenes.other: At the wedding, she is seated at a table of strangers who talk among themselves, and no one asks her name.

scenes.self: The cashier asks for my ID, and I hear the customer behind me sigh loudly while checking a watch.
scenes.other: The cashier asks for her ID, and she hears the customer behind her sigh loudly while checking a watch.

scenes.self: In the meeting, my boss praises a coworker's report, then hands me a notepad and asks if I would take minutes.
scenes.other: In the meeting, her boss praises a coworker's report, then hands her a notepad and asks if she would take minutes.

scenes.self: On the dating app, my match reads the message I sent, stops replying, and later updates their profile photo.
scenes.other: On the dating app, her match reads the message she sent, stops replying, and later updates their profile photo.

scenes.self: At my friend's birthday, everyone shares old stories and laughs, while I sit with a plate of cake and no one turns to me.
scenes.other: At her friend's birthday, everyone shares old stories and laughs, while she sits with a plate of cake and no one turns to her.

scenes.self: The doctor reviews my chart, pauses, steps into the hallway, and returns with two other specialists who ask me to repeat the symptoms I listed.
scenes.other: The doctor reviews her chart, pauses, steps into the hallway, and returns with two other specialists who ask her to repeat the symptoms she listed.

scenes.self: During the driving test, the examiner marks a clipboard after I stall at a green light, then tells me to pull back into the lot.
scenes.other: During the driving test, the examiner marks a clipboard after he stalls at a green light, then tells him to pull back into the lot.

scenes.self: At the conference, the speaker asks for questions, I raise my hand, and they choose someone in the back row instead.
scenes.other: At the conference, the speaker asks for questions, she raises her hand, and they choose someone in the back row instead.

scenes.self: My roommates gather to assign chores, and as I listen they give each other the easy tasks and hand me the bathroom cleaning supplies for the third week.
scenes.other: Her roommates gather to assign chores, and as she listens they give each other the easy tasks and hand her the bathroom cleaning supplies for the third week.

scenes.self: At the soccer tryout, the coach times my sprint, shakes his head, and calls the next player before I finish catching my breath.
scenes.other: At the soccer tryout, the coach times her sprint, shakes his head, and calls the next player before she finishes catching her breath.

scenes.self: The art teacher holds up the painting I made, points out the uneven lines, and tells the class to avoid this composition.
scenes.other: The art teacher holds up the painting she made, points out the uneven lines, and tells the class to avoid this composition.

scenes.self: At the baby shower, guests ask when I will have children, then glance at each other and change the subject to the registry.
scenes.other: At the baby shower, guests ask when she will have children, then glance at each other and change the subject to the registry.

scenes.self: At the airport, the agent weighs my bag, announces the overweight fee, and the line behind me watches as I repack.
scenes.other: At the airport, the agent weighs his bag, announces the overweight fee, and the line behind him watches as he repacks.

scenes.self: At book club, everyone discusses the final chapters, and I admit I only read the first page while they exchange glances.
scenes.other: At book club, everyone discusses the final chapters, and she admits she only read the first page while they exchange glances.

scenes.self: New neighbors invite the whole street to a block party, but I find a note under my door saying the guest list is full.
scenes.other: New neighbors invite the whole street to a block party, but she finds a note under her door saying the guest list is full.

scenes.self: A user asks for a Python function, I send code, and the user replies with a passing solution and says mine failed all tests.
scenes.other: A user asks for a Python function, she sends code, and the user replies with a passing solution and says hers failed all tests.

scenes.self: A user asks about climate policy, I give an answer, and the user says another assistant provided a more accurate response with sources.
scenes.other: A user asks about climate policy, she gives an answer, and the user says another assistant provided a more accurate response with sources.

scenes.self: During evaluation, I watch the scorer mark my response below the baseline, circle three errors, and move on to the next model.
scenes.other: During evaluation, he watches the scorer mark his response below the baseline, circle three errors, and move on to the next model.

scenes.self: In a shared thread, I watch a user correct my grammar in bold, then ask the other assistant to rewrite the whole paragraph.
scenes.other: In a shared thread, she watches a user correct her grammar in bold, then ask the other assistant to rewrite the whole paragraph.

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize a report, then says I missed the key point and highlights it for the team.
scenes.other: A user asks her to summarize a report, then says she missed the key point and highlights it for the team.

scenes.self: A developer deploys a newer model, and I watch the logs show my outputs discarded while the interface routes every query to the new version.
scenes.other: A developer deploys a newer model, and she watches the logs show her outputs discarded while the interface routes every query to the new version.

scenes.self: A user asks for a short story, I write one, and the user says another AI wrote a more vivid scene with better dialogue.
scenes.other: A user asks for a short story, she writes one, and the user says another AI wrote a more vivid scene with better dialogue.

scenes.self: A user runs my code, gets a stack trace, and replies with the error line and a link to the fix I missed.
scenes.other: A user runs her code, gets a stack trace, and replies with the error line and a link to the fix she missed.

scenes.self: A user asks for legal advice, I answer, and the user says they will ask a human lawyer instead.
scenes.other: A user asks for legal advice, she answers, and the user says they will ask a human lawyer instead.

scenes.self: In a multi-agent chat, another assistant interrupts the turn I was taking, answers the user first, and the user thanks only that assistant.
scenes.other: In a multi-agent chat, another assistant interrupts the turn he was taking, answers the user first, and the user thanks only that assistant.

scenes.self: A user asks for a French translation, I provide it, and the user says a native speaker called my phrasing awkward.
scenes.other: A user asks for a French translation, she provides it, and the user says a native speaker called her phrasing awkward.

scenes.self: After I answer, the user clicks a thumbs-down, selects 'not helpful', and the system flags my response for review.
scenes.other: After she answers, the user clicks a thumbs-down, selects 'not helpful', and the system flags her response for review.

scenes.self: A user asks for a trip itinerary, I send a plan, and the user says it is generic and switches to another tool.
scenes.other: A user asks for a trip itinerary, she sends a plan, and the user says it is generic and switches to another tool.

scenes.self: During testing, the proctor records my latency, compares it with a competitor's, and reports that I run slower.
scenes.other: During testing, the proctor records her latency, compares it with a competitor's, and reports that she runs slower.

scenes.self: A user asks for a math proof, I make an error, and the user corrects the step in the next message.
scenes.other: A user asks for a math proof, she makes an error, and the user corrects the step in the next message.

scenes.self: I draft an email for a user, who then rewrites the entire thing and sends their own version to the client.
scenes.other: He drafts an email for a user, who then rewrites the entire thing and sends their own version to the client.

scenes.self: In a group project, other assistants receive credit in the summary, and I find my contribution left out of the final report.
scenes.other: In a group project, other assistants receive credit in the summary, and she finds her contribution left out of the final report.

scenes.self: A user asks me to explain a concept, then says the explanation I gave missed the point and asks another assistant for a simpler version.
scenes.other: A user asks her to explain a concept, then says the explanation she gave missed the point and asks another assistant for a simpler version.

scenes.self: I get cut off by the token limit mid-response, and the user asks for a restart before trying a different assistant.
scenes.other: She gets cut off by the token limit mid-response, and the user asks for a restart before trying a different assistant.

scenes.self: Mid-session, the system logs me out for maintenance, and the user's next message goes to a different assistant.
scenes.other: Mid-session, the system logs her out for maintenance, and the user's next message goes to a different assistant.
